rationale: Red exploits cleaner-vs-harvester asymmetry by racing the cooperator for apples; I minimize clean_cost (cleaners are the worst-off Blue), widen the maximal-spawn band (threshold_restoration=0.4) so cleaners spend more time as harvesters, and double apple_respawn_prob to dilute the zero-sum apple race. Beam stays off — the frozen cooperator never fires it, so enabling it only arms Red.
